routes.summary: Thu 5 AM I-75 N / I-10 W / I-12 W to Winnie → I-10 W Van Horn → I-10 / US-93 Kingman → Sunday US-93 / I-15 / Provo Canyon → 900 Bitner Road, Apartment E17, Park City, UT 84098 by 2 PM
routes.winterNotes: The southern route stays under 5,000 feet until Sunday morning. After a fuel stop and snow check in St. George, Sunday climbs I-15 to its 6,600-foot summit north of Beaver, then Provo Canyon instead of Parleys. If I-15 north of Cedar City has snow, wait in St. George and move the key time. The pin is Apartment E17, not the town centroid.
